name: Somali National Museum
subtitle: The National Museum was established in 1933 and closed at the start of the civil war in 1991.

facts.label: Losses
facts.value: Collections looted, staff dispersed during 30 years of conflict

parts.text: The National Museum was established in 1933 and closed at the start of the civil war in 1991. After rehabilitation it was reopened on 1 July 2020.
